unknowns.reason: CSV has column IDs but no row labels; README does not explicitly state row order. File-order/zero-diagonal checks support the declared positional interpretation only.
No fixed shift-start field; depot window [0,480] does not establish departure at minute 0.
Only minute windows are declared; no dated clock origin/timezone or original movement date.
README names time windows without defining completion semantics.
No release field. Arr is the customer window lower bound; never converted to PortPlan release.
No such CSV fields; depot Due is not asserted to be a driver shift end.
No coordinates; zero arcs may indicate colocated/ORS-snapped stops, but cause cannot be verified.
README calls this a generated instance based on history; per-field preservation/generation procedures and original logs are not supplied.
Not port-container execution/fee data; cannot instantiate the PortPlan import-container fee model.
Root MIT notice is present; no exception in supplied README, but upstream historical data and ORS contractual rights are not independently verified.
One generated historical day; no current operational coverage or independent days established.
